version.author: sastraxi
version.changelog: Readable action names: "Webshare - Export stems" (panel), "Webshare - Export stems now (no window)", "Webshare - Toggle selected tracks for export". Replaces the old webshare_* actions; re-add any toolbar buttons or shortcuts you made for them. Panel: no more stray scrollbar; time selection shown as clock time and bars.

source.file: Webshare - Toggle selected tracks for export.lua

version.author: sastraxi
version.changelog: Shared export folder: set once at the top of the panel and it applies to every project. Exports go to <folder>/<project name>/<date time>/. Leave it empty to keep exporting next to each project. Browse uses REAPER's folder picker on newer REAPER versions, or js_ReaScriptAPI's if it's installed.

source.file: Webshare - Toggle selected tracks for export.lua
